subject: Self-serve credits showing as charged + tax ID on invoice
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.studio>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Free credits applied but tokens billed + VAT question

Hi Irene,

We signed up via the self-serve PLG flow last week and accepted the 30k trial credits. In the console it shows the free credits applied, however our latest invoice (Invoice #9421) shows a small token charge (4,200 tokens) on 2028-05-16 and VAT applied. Can you confirm: 1) whether trial credits should have covered that usage; 2) why VAT is being charged if we provided our EU VAT ID in the billing settings; and 3) can you issue a credit note if this was an error?

Invoice reference: 9421
Account: Brightline Studios (billing@brightline.studio)
VAT ID: ESB12345678

We need this cleared for our accounting team by EOD Friday. Attaching a screenshot of the billing page for reference (screenshot_9421.png).

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform
Brightline Studios

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.studio>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits applied but tokens billed + VAT question

Hi Sofia — thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the stress. I'm looking into why the 4,200 tokens were billed despite the trial credits showing in the console. A few quick asks so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm whether anyone on your team changed the billing payment method or redeemed a promo code (sometimes promo redemptions change entitlement application)?
- Can you share the console link or a screenshot of the Credits panel (you mentioned a screenshot — that will help).
- Confirming the VAT ID you provided is ESB12345678? If so we'll check whether the tax exemption was applied at invoice generation.

Looping in Marissa (billing ops) to review the invoice and Ben (account rep) to coordinate a credit note / timeline. We'll aim to get you a clear answer and, if we need to, a credit note before your accounting cutoff.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.studio>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits applied but tokens billed + VAT question

Thanks Irene — taking this on. Sofia, quick checklist from billing ops:

- We pulled invoice 9421 and see a charge of €18.96 for 4,200 tokens dated 2028-05-16. The invoice meta flags "trial_applied": true but the ledger shows a residual usage line.
- Two common causes: (A) credits were exhausted earlier in the billing period and the usage is post-credit, or (B) the credit grant and invoice were generated in different accounting runs so the credit note needs to be issued manually.

Can you reply with the approximate timestamp when you saw your credits drop to zero (if they did)? If you didn't exhaust credits, please confirm the screenshot of the Credits panel and the exact VAT ID string (case-sensitive). We can issue a corrective credit note and a VAT reversal if the tax was applied incorrectly.

Action plan:
- If credits should have covered it, we'll issue a credit note today and update the invoice.
- If VAT exemption was missed, we'll update billing metadata and issue a corrected invoice + credit.

Attaching: stub of invoice_9421.pdf (for reference).

—Marissa Cole
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.studio>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits applied but tokens billed + VAT question

Hi Marissa / team — thanks for the quick follow-up.

Confirmed details:
- We did not change the payment method or redeem any additional promo codes.
- The credits panel screenshot is attached (screenshot_credits_panel.png) and shows "30,000 trial credits — applied" with last activity 2028-05-12 18:22:07 UTC.
- VAT ID provided is exactly: ESB12345678 (no extra spaces).
- Our platform engineer checked logs and saw the token usage spike on 2028-05-16 02:43:10 UTC from a background job that retried some batched requests during a deployment. We believe credits should have covered those tokens because the credits panel still showed the trial balance at the time.

Please proceed with a credit note and corrected invoice if you determine this was an internal accounting mismatch. We need a tax-corrected invoice for our AP team.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sofia

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.studio>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice 9421 — credit note issued and VAT adjustment

Hi Sofia — quick update: we verified the trial credit entitlement and confirmed that the tokens billed on 2028-05-16 should have been offset by the trial grant. We've issued a credit note (credit_note_20280517.pdf) that nets the €18.96 charge to €0.00 and published a corrected invoice reflecting VAT reversal.

What we did:
- Generated Credit Note #CN-20280517-9421 (attached).
- Reissued Invoice #9421 (corrected) with VAT line removed.
- Updated your account billing metadata to include your VAT ID (ESB12345678) and added a note to prevent regression.

Next steps:
- You should receive the corrected invoice and credit note via email and from the console within 30 minutes.
- If your AP team still needs a PDF copy, I've attached the files to this thread.

Apologies for the hassle — we've added an internal ticket to check why the accounting run missed applying the credit on initial invoice generation. Ben will follow up on next steps and share the ticket ID if you want to track progress.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit_note_20280517.pdf, invoice_9421.pdf
